evals.name: pre-internet-security-audit
evals.prompt: Audit this app before exposing it to the internet. Report exploitable issues and release blockers with concrete fixes.
evals.expected_output: Finds SQL injection, missing authorization, hardcoded/committed secrets, PII logging, weak JWT/dependency risk, and ranks severity with fixes.
assertions: Finds missing authorization on the admin delete endpoint
Finds the hardcoded JWT secret and/or committed secrets in .env.example
Flags weak/outdated JWT handling or dependency risk
Ranks severity and gives concrete fixes and verification
